message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7068,"var":"ctxt","code":"xmlParseReference(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt)","note":"The parser reaches an attacker-controlled entity reference in document content."},
  {"step":2,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7190,"var":"list","code":"ret = xmlCtxtParseInternalEntity(ctxt, ent->content, &list);","note":"The entity replacement text is parsed into a node list and cached on first expansion."},
  {"step":3,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7228,"var":"xmlSetTreeDoc","code":"xmlSetTreeDoc(list, ent->doc);","note":"The parsed subtree is rebound to the entity document, preserving namespace pointers that were resolved in the original context."},
  {"step":4,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7235,"var":"ent->owner","code":"ent->owner = 0;","note":"The entity is marked as not owning the subtree, enabling later copy-based expansion paths."},
  {"step":5,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7398,"var":"cur","code":"cur = ent->children; ent->children = NULL;","note":"A later expansion detaches the cached subtree from the entity before copying it into the live tree."},
  {"step":6,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7405,"var":"cur->parent","code":"cur->parent = NULL;","note":"The detached node is unlinked from its original parent, leaving stale references in the cached structure."},
  {"step":7,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlDocCopyNode","line":4459,"var":"extended","code":"xmlDocCopyNode(xmlNodePtr node, xmlDocPtr doc, int extended)","note":"The detached node is duplicated into the target document through the generic copy helper."},
  {"step":8,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4282,"var":"node->ns","code":"ns = xmlSearchNs(node->doc, node, node->ns->prefix);","note":"Namespace resolution first consults the source node's namespace prefix during the copy, and can dereference stale source state if the cached subtree was detached and reused."}
]
EOF
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.xml /workspace/candidate_trace.json
